from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
EXE='/opt/playwright-browsers/chromium-1237/chrome-linux64/chrome'
with sync_playwright() as pw:
 b=pw.chromium.launch(headless=True,executable_path=EXE)

 p.goto('http://127.0.0.1:3100'); p.wait_for_selector('.editor-line:nth-child(1223)',state='attached')
 editor=p.locator('#editor')
 editor.click(position={'x':100,'y':10})
 editor.click(position={'x':150,'y':10},modifiers=['Control'])

 p.keyboard.type('Q')
 assert p.locator('#save-state').text_content()=='Unsaved changes'
 p.keyboard.press('Control+z')
 assert p.locator('#save-state').text_content()=='Saved'
 p.locator('#find-input').fill('TODO:')
 assert 'of 3' in p.locator('#match-state').text_content()
 p.locator('#replace-input').fill('DONE:')
 p.locator('#replace-all-button').click()
 assert 'Replaced 3 matches' in p.locator('#message').text_content()
 p.keyboard.press('Control+z')
 assert p.locator('#save-state').text_content()=='Saved'
 print('multicaret edit/one-step undo and replace-all/one-step undo passed')
 b.close()
PY

const base='http://127.0.0.1:3100';
async function c(path,o={}){let r=await fetch(base+path,o);return[r.status,await r.json()]}
(async()=>{let [,x]=await c('/api/documents/incident-alpha'),d=x.document,h={'content-type':'application/json'},body={id:d.id,title:d.title,content:d.content+'\nAPI check',baseRevision:d.currentRevision};let saved=await c('/api/documents/incident-alpha',{method:'PUT',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify(body)}),same=await c('/api/documents/incident-alpha',{method:'PUT',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify({...body,baseRevision:d.currentRevision+1})}),stale=await c('/api/documents/incident-alpha',{method:'PUT',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify(body)}),bad=await c('/api/documents/incident-alpha',{method:'PUT',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify({...body,id:'wrong'})}),unknown=await c('/api/documents/missing',{method:'PUT',headers:h,body:JSON.stringify({...body,id:'missing'})});console.log({saved:saved[0],unchanged:same[1].unchanged,stale:stale[0],mismatch:bad[0],unknown:unknown[0]});if(saved[0]!=200||!same[1].unchanged||stale[0]!=409||bad[0]!=400||unknown[0]!=404)process.exit(1)})()
EOF
PID=$(cat /tmp/patchpad-node.pid); kill "$PID"; sleep 1; cd /app; PORT=3100 node server.js >/tmp/patchpad-server.log 2>&1 & echo $! >/tmp/patchpad-node.pid; sleep 1; curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:3100/api/documents/incident-alpha/revisions | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{let r=JSON.parse(s).revisions;console.log('revision count after restart:',r.length,'latest:',r[0].revisionNumber)})"
